summary: Western Digital Corp filed an 8-K Item 8.01 disclosing privately negotiated exchange agreements with institutional investors. The company will exchange 1,038,681 shares of Sandisk Corp common stock it holds for an equal-value number of shares of its own common stock, based on three-day volume-weighted average prices from June 16-18, 2026. The exchange closes June 22, 2026. This is an in-kind swap reducing Western Digital's Sandisk stake, not a conventional M&A or capital-return event; no premium, break fee, or board recommendation is cited. Watch for any subsequent 13D/13G filings from investors adjusting holdings post-closing.
